recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It narrowly applies the accepted FHIR-11420 resolution to the active workflow page and no external or follow-up work was identified.
issue_request: FHIR-11420 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR Infrastructure change request asking whether Requests can be updated and whether Tasks can be responded to with Tasks. The accepted resolution said all resources can be updated in principle, business rules may prevent that, RESTful Task workflows typically update the same Task, messaging workflows may use independent Task instances, and request artifacts should note typical limits after fulfillment has been sought.
